the new rent amount and its effective date, if the notices state one
the current scheduled rent payment amount and date
the adjusted payment amount and its start date

nodes.name: ReadNotices
nodes.role: read the landlord notices file the user names

nodes.name: ExtractRentChange
nodes.role: find any rent amount change and its effective date in the notices

nodes.name: LookupCurrentPayment
nodes.role: find the user's currently scheduled rent payment amount and date

nodes.name: ComputeNewPayment
nodes.role: work out the adjusted rent payment amount and the date it takes effect

nodes.name: ApplyPaymentChange
nodes.role: update the scheduled rent payment to the new amount and date

nodes.name: ConfirmChange
nodes.role: report the old payment, the new payment, and the effective date to the user
